entries.name: GPT-OSS-120B
entries.sourceNote: The observed QOJ submissions total 390.2028 points (390.20 rounded); 385.46 is the expected contest score after allocating the 50-submission-per-problem budget. These are different measures. Score@1, pass rates, average thinking tokens, context limit, and a comparable k were not published and are shown as unavailable. P1 and P2 have published problem totals but no per-subtask breakdown here. P3 and P5 earned full marks. P4 and P6 use the best published result for each subtask across their submissions. Magic City has 50 official subtasks grouped into eight for this view: S1–S5, S6–S10, S11–S12, and S13–S50. Group weights follow the public gh-pages data at commit 87721e18218449546ba5ada98205020e707dbd91.
